finding: Routine urinary catheterization in women undergoing elective caesarean section significantly increased the odds of postoperative dysuria, frequency, urgency, urinary tract infections, antimicrobial use, and length of hospital stay
mod_finding: Women undergoing elective cesarean sections who had routine urinary catheterization experienced significantly higher rates of postoperative dysuria, urinary frequency, urinary urgency, UTIs, and required more postoperative antimicrobials compared to those who did not have routine catheterization.
